title: gonostemon deflexus var. atropurpureus
intro: Gonostemon deflexus var. atropurpureus, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family native to southern Africa. The health benefits of Devil's Claw include its anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties, making it a popular remedy for arthritis and other musculoskeletal conditions. The therapeutic actions of Devil's Claw include its ability to inhibit prostaglandin synthesis, reduce inflammation, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Devil's Claw include harpagoside, a unique iridoid glycoside responsible for its medicinal properties.
